items.title: US lifts Anthropic export controls — Claude Fable 5 restored globally
items.title_zh: 美国解除Anthropic出口管制，Claude Fable 5全球恢复
items.summary: After weeks of negotiation with the Trump administration, the Department of Commerce lifted export controls on Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5. The company will begin restoring access globally on Claude platforms, AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure starting July 1.

items.title: Anthropic launches Claude Science — its newest flagship product for scientific research
items.title_zh: Anthropic发布Claude Science——针对科学研究的全新旗舰产品
items.summary: At an event for pharmaceutical executives and biotech founders, Anthropic announced Claude Science — a workbench that autonomously carries out computational research when given high-level instructions, analogous to Claude Code acting as a coding co-pilot for scientists.

items.title: Anthropic launches Claude Sonnet 5 as a cheaper way to run agents
items.title_zh: Anthropic发布Claude Sonnet 5，作为运行智能体的更低价选择
items.summary: Anthropic announced Claude Sonnet 5 with stronger agentic capabilities, lower pricing, and improved safety, positioning it as a cheaper alternative to Opus while competing with GPT-5.5 and Gemini Pro on agent workflows.

items.title: Tesla starts testing Cybercab without pedals or a steering wheel in Austin
items.title_zh: 特斯拉开始在奥斯汀测试无踏板和无方向盘的Cybercab
items.summary: Tesla began engineering tests of its first production-spec Cybercab on public roads in Austin — without pedals or a steering wheel — marking a concrete step toward Elon Musk's years-long promise of launching a robotaxi network.

items.title: UBTECH U1 humanoid companion robot secures 11,000+ orders at up to ¥990,000 price
items.title_zh: 优必选U1超仿生人形机器人首发订单破万，最高售价99万元
items.summary: 优必选发布全尺寸超仿生人形机器人U1系列（售价11.98万元至99万元），全渠道订单累计突破13361台，成为全球首款具备规模化量产能力的全尺寸超仿生人形机器人。

items.title: NVIDIA expands robotics hiring in China — new roles in Beijing, Shanghai, and Shenzhen
items.title_zh: 英伟达扩大中国机器人团队招聘，在北京/上海/深圳开设岗位
items.summary: NVIDIA announced a major recruitment drive for its robotics team across four core areas — embodied AI, simulation, deployment, and solution architecture — with positions in Beijing, Shanghai, and Shenzhen focusing on dexterous manipulation, human body modeling, and foundation models.

items.title: Claude Code discovered to be steganographically marking requests
items.title_zh: Claude Code被发现以隐写术标记请求
items.summary: A developer discovered that Claude Code is embedding steganographic markers in prompts — hidden metadata invisible to users — sparking discussion on HN (1,908 points, 547 comments) about transparency and trust in AI coding tools.

items.title: Gemini Spark rolls out to macOS app for local tasks and automation
items.title_zh: Gemini Spark推出macOS应用，支持本地任务与自动化
items.summary: As previewed at I/O 2026, Google launched Gemini Spark for macOS — a 24/7 personal agent available to Google AI Ultra subscribers that handles local tasks and automations, with third-party app and MCP support.

items.title: OpenAI's personal finance features for ChatGPT expand to Plus subscribers
items.title_zh: OpenAI ChatGPT个人理财功能扩展至Plus用户
items.summary: OpenAI expanded ChatGPT's personal finance features from the $100/month Pro tier to the $20/month Plus tier in the US, broadening access to AI-assisted financial management tools within the chatbot.

items.title: NotebookLM adding Short Video Overviews powered by Nano Banana 2 Lite
items.title_zh: NotebookLM新增由Nano Banana 2 Lite驱动的短视频概览功能
items.summary: Google announced Nano Banana 2 Lite as its latest media generation model, alongside Gemini Omni Flash in preview, and integrated Short Video Overviews into NotebookLM — adding video-based content summaries to the AI research tool.

items.title: 8点1氪 daily roundup: EV battery safety mandate, Apple data breach, OpenAI hardware leak
items.title_zh: 8点1氪｜史上最严电池安全令施行；苹果大量机密文件遭泄露；OpenAI首款硬件曝光
items.summary: 36氪早间汇总：7月1日起电动汽车电池安全新国标正式施行，首次将一键断电定义为物理断电装置；苹果供应商塔塔电子遭入侵，数百GB机密文件（含iPhone 18 Pro跌落测试照片）遭泄露；OpenAI首款硬件被曝光。

items.title: Pony.ai CEO: Robotaxis at scale — the invisible logistics of going driverless
items.title_zh: 小马智行CEO彭军谈Robotaxi落地：看不见的运维才是规模化关键
items.summary: 小马智行CEO彭军接受36氪专访，谈及Robotaxi商业化运营的挑战：无人驾驶后充电、洗车、搬运行李等琐碎运维成为制约车队扩张的关键瓶颈，公司已组建专业运营团队；同时解释了为何暂未布局具身智能。

items.title: DexForce becomes embodied-AI unicorn amidst billion-yuan funding + tops WorldArena benchmark
items.title_zh: 跨维智能完成超10亿融资晋升具身智能独角兽，登顶WorldArena基准
items.summary: Shenzhen-based embodied-AI company DexForce completed multiple funding rounds totaling over ¥1 billion, pushing its valuation into unicorn territory, while simultaneously achieving the top ranking on the WorldArena global benchmark for embodied world models.

items.title: Ex-Xiaomi executive launches food-service humanoid robot, targets year-end production
items.title_zh: 前小米高管唐沐推出餐饮服务人形机器人，目标年底量产
items.summary: InSpace Technology, founded by former Xiaomi executive Tang Mu, unveiled three new food-service humanoid robots at a June 30 product launch event, with a target of entering production by the end of the year.

items.title: Robot e-skin startup Perception Era lands angel round from Songhe Capital
items.title_zh: 机器人电子皮肤创业公司感知纪元获松禾资本天使轮投资
items.summary: 感知纪元科技完成千万级天使轮融资，由松禾资本领投。公司定位机器人触觉基础设施提供商，通过自研多模态电子皮肤、触觉感知硬件及AI算法，为机器人提供完整触觉系统。创始人刘瑞远为苏州大学特聘教授。

items.title: google/agents-cli
items.title_zh: google/agents-cli — Google AI智能体CLI与技能工具集
items.summary: agents-cli provides the CLI and skills that turn any coding assistant into an expert at creating, evaluating, and deploying AI agents on Google Cloud.

items.title: facebook/astryx
items.title_zh: facebook/astryx — Meta开源智能体就绪设计系统
items.summary: Astryx is Meta's open-source design system that is fully customizable and built to be agent-ready for AI-assisted UI development workflows.

items.title: obra/superpowers
items.title_zh: obra/superpowers — 智能体技能框架与软件开发方法论
items.summary: Superpowers is an agentic skills framework and software development methodology that defines reusable agent capabilities and structured development workflows.

items.title: usestrix/strix
items.title_zh: usestrix/strix — 开源AI渗透测试工具
items.summary: Strix is an open-source AI penetration-testing tool designed to find and fix application vulnerabilities through automated security analysis.

items.title: EnclaveX: End-to-End Confidential AI with CPU/GPU TEEs
items.title_zh: EnclaveX：基于CPU/GPU TEE的端到端机密AI
items.summary: NVIDIA researchers present EnclaveX, an end-to-end confidential computing framework using CPU and GPU Trusted Execution Environments, enabling LLM deployments that protect sensitive user data from centralized infrastructure operators like Azure, Google Cloud, or AWS.

items.title: SpikON: A Dual-Parallel and Efficient Accelerator for Online Spiking Neural Networks Learning
items.title_zh: SpikON：面向在线脉冲神经网络学习的双并行高效加速器
items.summary: Apple researchers propose SpikON, a dual-parallel accelerator architecture for energy-efficient online spiking neural network learning, addressing the accuracy and scalability limitations of existing unsupervised SNN training for brain-inspired computing.

items.title: MECoBench: A Systematic Study of Multimodal Agent Collaboration in Embodied Environments
items.title_zh: MECoBench：具身环境中多模态智能体协作的系统研究
items.summary: MECoBench introduces a multimodal embodied cooperation benchmark and evaluation platform spanning diverse collaborative tasks, probing whether multimodal LLMs can effectively collaborate as agents in visually-grounded environments.

items.title: AgRefactor: Self-Evolving Agentic Workflow for HLS Compatibility and Performance
items.title_zh: AgRefactor：面向HLS兼容性与性能的自进化智能体工作流
items.summary: AgRefactor proposes a self-evolving agentic workflow for High-Level Synthesis that converts real-world software into synthesizable HLS code, bridging the gap between software programming practices and hardware design constraints through iterative LLM-guided refactoring.

items.title: GEAR: Guided End-to-End AutoRegression for Image Synthesis
items.title_zh: GEAR：面向图像合成的引导式端到端自回归
items.summary: GEAR presents a guided end-to-end autoregression framework for image synthesis, breaking the traditional two-stage tokenizer-then-generator pipeline by jointly optimizing both stages so the tokenizer learns what the generator finds easy to model.

items.title: FlexViT: A Flexible FPGA-Based Accelerator for Edge Vision Transformers
items.title_zh: FlexViT：面向边缘Vision Transformer的灵活FPGA加速器
items.summary: FlexViT proposes a flexible FPGA-based accelerator architecture for deploying heterogeneous Vision Transformer models on edge platforms, addressing the computational challenges of hybrid ViT workloads that mix convolutional and attention layers.
